identity_policy.rule: Heroes III rendering language; independently designed Zaunit silhouettes, equipment and actions. No renamed or recoloured original troop sprites, and no shared Demacian or Noxian art.

original_resource_references: Structure and rendering language only: original Heroes III creature, town and siege layouts measured for scale.
release_policy: Every required output needs an approved source, a recorded checksum, redistribution rights and native-size visual acceptance. No placeholders.
visual_direction: Original Heroes III Castle native painted compatibility, rendered with Zaun subjects, corroded iron and chemical haze, industrial ruins and pit-fighting imagery.
